title: Unshared zeros of Dirichlet $L$-functions
summary: We prove that no Dirichlet $L$-function (and more generally, no nontrivial finite linear combination of Dirichlet $L$-functions) can vanish at every zero of a fixed $L(s,χ_0)$. At the heart of the proof is a short-window asymptotic for the twisted discrete moment $\sum_ρ x^ρ L(ρ,χ_1)$, where $χ_0\neχ_1$ are primitive Dirichlet characters, $ρ=β+iγ$ runs over zeros of $L(s,χ_0)$ with $T-Δ<γ\le T$, and $x\in\mathbb{Z}$.
